name: com.shoe-fit/shoe-fit
title: Shoe Fit
description: Cross-brand shoe size recommendations, fit comparisons, and verified brand size charts.

tools.name: search_shoe_models
tools.description: Search the Shoe Fit database for shoe brands and models by keyword, brand slug, or gender. Always use this tool first to resolve natural language shoe names (like 'Nike Pegasus 40' or 'Adidas Samba') into canonical `modelSlug` and `brandSlug` identifiers.

query.description: Search keywords matching brand or shoe model name (e.g. 'Nike Pegasus', 'Samba', 'Clifton 9').

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return (1-25, default 10).

tools.name: recommend_shoe_size
tools.description: Calculate the exact recommended shoe size (EU, US, UK) for a target shoe model (`toModelSlug`) using millimeter cavity measurements and real-world fit offsets. Supports recommending from a reference shoe the user owns (`fromModelSlug` + `fromSize`) or from a direct foot measurement (`footLengthMm`).

toModelSlug.description: Target shoe model slug the user wants to buy (use search_shoe_models first to get the canonical slug).

fromModelSlug.description: Reference shoe model slug the user already owns. Provide either (fromModelSlug + fromSize) or footLengthMm.

fromSize.description: Size the user wears in the reference shoe (e.g. '42.5', '10', '42 2/3', 'US 10.5').

sizeSystem.description: Sizing system of fromSize ('EU', 'US', or 'UK'). Auto-detected if omitted.

footLengthMm.description: Direct heel-to-toe foot length in millimeters (e.g. 265) if no reference shoe is provided.

lengthRating.description: How the reference shoe fits in length: 1=very tight, 2=slightly snug, 3=true to size (default), 4=slightly roomy, 5=very loose.

widthRating.description: How the reference shoe fits in width: 1=snug/wide foot, 2=standard width (default), 3=roomy/narrow foot.

tools.name: compare_shoe_models
tools.description: Compare sizing, millimeter internal length/width offsets, community fit statistics, and full size-by-size conversion tables between two shoe models (`modelSlugA` and `modelSlugB`).

tools.name: get_brand_size_chart
tools.description: Retrieve the official EU / US / UK / millimeter foot-length size chart for a shoe brand (e.g. 'nike', 'adidas', 'hoka', 'birkenstock'), or list all supported brands if `brandSlug` is omitted.

brandSlug.description: Brand slug (e.g. 'nike', 'adidas', 'hoka'). Omit to list all available brands.

gender.description: Optional gender ('men', 'women', or 'unisex') to resolve the gender-specific size ladder.
